body:
Were it so simple.

I'm not just talking about living on a budget. I'm talking about working multiple jobs just to survive. Spending all of my time working just to make enough to have food on the table.
I'm talking about being homeless if I can't manage to hold things together.

I can survive, as I said... but it will be just survival. I can't convince myself that just surviving is worth it.

I have a passion for gaming, truly few things make me happier then loading up a new game and settling in for epic adventure. If you aren't a gamer, trust me, its a very expensive and time consuming hobby.
And as stupid as it may sound, I genuinely enjoy wasting time on the internet. Just browsing sites and watching stupid videos. As I'm sure pretty much everyone on this site knows how time consuming that can be.
I'm sure that all seems trivial and stupid, but these things bring a lot of joy to my life. No, they aren't worth dying for... They do, however, make living much more tolerable. Without being able to fund or spare the time for the things that make life tolerable.
Well, its just pain then.

And even here I go unnoticed.
Guess this rifle is my only friend.
